settings.html:
<!-- Landing layout: one vertical rhythm for every section, split form and FAQ, CTA strip.
     Only loaded on the landing page, so plain vanta-* selectors affect nothing else. -->
<style id="vk-layout">
:root{--vk-sec:120px;--vk-ink:#11131b;--vk-gold:#c3a15a;--vk-gold-dark:#a9853f;--vk-cream:#f7f5f1;--vk-text:#383b45;--vk-muted:#62605c;--vk-line:#d8d9df}
@media (max-width:1024px){:root{--vk-sec:88px}}
@media (max-width:767px){:root{--vk-sec:64px}}

/* hero photo and section grounds set here, so they never depend on Elementor's generated CSS file */
.vanta-service-hero--default{--vanta-service-hero-bg:url("https://vantasurfaces.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/photo_2026-10-07_02-44-43.jpg")!important;--vanta-service-hero-bg-position:center 60%!important;--vanta-service-hero-mobile-bg-position:62% center!important}
.vk-split{background:#fff!important}
.vk-faq{background:var(--vk-cream)!important}
.vk-faq .vanta-faq{background:transparent!important}

/* one rhythm: every section gets the same top and bottom space */
.vanta-service-inclusions__inner,.vanta-service-details__inner,.vanta-google-reviews__inner,.vanta-before-rendering-after__inner,.vanta-faq__inner{padding-top:var(--vk-sec)!important;padding-bottom:var(--vk-sec)!important}
.vanta-service-inclusions,.vanta-service-details,.vanta-google-reviews,.vanta-before-rendering-after,.vanta-faq{padding-top:0!important;padding-bottom:0!important;margin:0!important}

/* three options: heading and intro sit together */
.vanta-service-inclusions__intro{row-gap:18px!important;gap:18px!important;margin-bottom:56px!important}
.vanta-service-inclusions__intro-heading{margin:0!important}
.vanta-service-inclusions__intro-text{margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.vanta-service-inclusions__intro-text p{margin:0!important}

/* "not sure" strip becomes a call to action, not a status message */
.vanta-service-inclusions__cta-strip{display:flex!important;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:24px!important;padding:28px 32px!important;background:var(--vk-ink)!important;border:0!important;border-radius:3px}
.vanta-service-inclusions__cta-strip .vanta-service-inclusions__check{display:none!important}
.vanta-service-inclusions__cta-strip .vanta-service-inclusions__strip-text{color:#f5f5f7!important;font:400 18px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif!important;max-width:640px}
.vanta-service-inclusions__cta-strip .vanta-service-inclusions__strip-text strong{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:4px}
.vk-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--vk-gold);color:var(--vk-ink)!important;font:700 15px/1 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none!important;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s ease,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.vk-btn:hover{background:#d0b06b}
.vk-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.vk-btn--ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

/* estimate: dark "what happens next" panel + the site form */
.vk-split{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,7fr);gap:32px!important;align-items:stretch;margin:0!important;padding:var(--vk-sec) max(64px,calc((100% - 1312px)/2))!important;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%}
.vk-split>.elementor-element{width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0!important}
.vk-next{height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:var(--vk-ink);color:#b7b8c2;border-radius:3px;padding:48px 44px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.vk-next::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;right:-180px;top:-160px;border:1px solid rgba(195,161,90,.25);border-radius:50%}
.vk-eyebrow{margin:0!important;color:var(--vk-gold)!important;font:700 15px/1.3 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.vk-next h2,.vk-faq-side h2{margin:0;font:700 clamp(30px,2.6vw,40px)/1.12 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.vk-next h2{color:#f5f5f7}
.vk-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:22px}
.vk-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.vk-steps li>span{color:#e4d5b7;font:300 30px/1 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.vk-steps strong{display:block;color:#fff;font:700 18px/1.3 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;margin-bottom:4px}
.vk-steps p{margin:0;font:400 16px/1.55 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.vk-next__contact{margin-top:auto;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);display:grid;gap:6px}
.vk-next__contact a{color:#fff!important;font:700 26px/1.2 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;text-decoration:none!important}
.vk-next__contact a:hover{color:var(--vk-gold)!important}
.vk-next__contact span{font:400 14px/1.5 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.vk-next__stars{color:#f7bd38;letter-spacing:2px}
.vk-split .vanta-estimate-form{padding:0!important;background:transparent!important;height:100%}
.vk-split .vanta-estimate-form__inner{max-width:none!important;padding:0!important;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.vk-split .vanta-estimate-form__header{display:none!important}
.vk-split .vanta-estimate-form__form-shell{max-width:none!important;margin:0!important;flex:1;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -40px rgba(17,19,27,.35)!important;border:1px solid var(--vk-line)}

/* FAQ: heading column + questions */
.vk-faq{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,4fr) minmax(0,8fr);gap:64px!important;align-items:start;margin:0!important;padding:var(--vk-sec) max(64px,calc((100% - 1312px)/2))!important;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%}
.vk-faq>.elementor-element{width:auto!important;max-width:none!important;margin:0!important}
.vk-faq-side{position:sticky;top:120px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px}
.vk-faq-side h2{color:var(--vk-ink)}
.vk-faq-side p{margin:0;color:var(--vk-text);font:400 18px/1.6 Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif}
.vk-faq-side a.vk-link{color:var(--vk-ink)!important;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:var(--vk-gold);text-underline-offset:5px}
.vk-faq .vanta-faq__intro{display:none!important}
.vk-faq .vanta-faq__inner{padding:0!important;max-width:none!important;display:block!important}
.vk-faq .vanta-faq__list{max-width:none!important;margin:0!important}
.vk-faq-wrap{background:#fff}

@media (max-width:1024px){
  .vk-split,.vk-faq{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:var(--vk-sec) 32px!important;gap:28px!important}
  .vk-faq-side{position:static}
  .vk-split>.elementor-widget-vanta_estimate_form{order:-1}
  .vk-next{gap:20px}
}
@media (max-width:767px){
  .vk-split,.vk-faq{padding:var(--vk-sec) 16px!important}
  .vk-next{padding:32px 24px}
  .vanta-service-inclusions__cta-strip{padding:24px!important}
  .vk-btn{width:100%}
}
</style>

settings.heading: Kitchen renovation questions
settings.description: Answers to what owners usually ask before requesting an estimate.

items.question: Can I remodel my kitchen without changing the existing layout?
items.answer: Yes. Keeping your kitchen's existing layout can reduce renovation costs and construction time. Vanta Surfaces can replace kitchen cabinets, countertops, backsplashes, flooring, and lighting while maintaining the current plumbing and appliance locations. This is a practical option for NYC apartment owners who want a modern kitchen without a complete redesign.

items.question: Do I need board approval in a co-op or condo?
items.answer: For most work beyond a refresh, yes. We prepare the alteration paperwork, certificates of insurance and work schedule your building asks for, and coordinate with the managing agent.

items.question: Can you remodel a small or galley kitchen in NYC?
items.answer: Yes. Vanta Surfaces renovates small apartment kitchens, narrow galley kitchens, and other compact NYC kitchen layouts. Improvements may include space-efficient cabinetry, additional storage, updated countertops, better lighting, and durable flooring. We focus on making the available space more functional without unnecessary structural changes.

items.question: Can I change the layout of my kitchen during a renovation?
items.answer: Kitchen layouts can often be modified, depending on the property's plumbing, electrical systems, structural conditions, and building restrictions. Changes may include relocating cabinets, repositioning appliances, or opening up the kitchen to an adjoining living area. Vanta Surfaces reviews the proposed changes and coordinates the necessary construction work and licensed trades.

items.question: Does Vanta Surfaces provide kitchen renovations for rental properties?
items.answer: Yes. We work with landlords, property managers, and real estate investors on kitchen renovations in NYC rental apartments. Projects may involve cabinet replacement, new countertops, backsplashes, flooring, painting, and fixture upgrades. The scope can be planned around the property's condition, renovation budget, and upcoming tenant occupancy.

items.question: How do I get a kitchen remodeling estimate in New York City?
items.answer: To request an estimate from Vanta Surfaces, provide your property address, photos of the existing kitchen, approximate measurements, and a description of the improvements you want. If you have drawings, material preferences, or a target budget, include those as well. We review the project details and determine whether an on-site visit is needed before preparing a detailed renovation proposal.
